metadata.name: 260913-termboard_model_repository_v04_corrected
metadata.description: Repository concept model v04 (corrected) - Faceted classification using ONLY standard SKOS/RDFS/OWL predicates. No custom properties. Uses skos:inScheme via parent field.

mappings.name: parent
mappings.desc: (Term id) Parent term to create a group

terms.name: repository
terms.description: A centralized, version-controlled storage system. Hub concept linked to multiple independent facets (Content, Structure, Process, Tool, Scope).
terms.additionalInformation: skos:topConceptOf ContentScheme, StructureScheme, ProcessScheme, ToolScheme, ScopeScheme

terms.name: ContentScheme
terms.description: Facet: What the repository stores or contains.

terms.name: CodeContent
terms.description: Source code files and programming assets.

terms.name: DocumentContent
terms.description: Documentation, guides, and knowledge base entries.

terms.name: DataContent
terms.description: Datasets, schemas, and configuration files.

terms.name: ArtifactContent
terms.description: Build artifacts, libraries, and binaries.

terms.name: ConfigContent
terms.description: Environment configuration and infrastructure as code.

terms.name: StructureScheme
terms.description: Facet: How the repository is organized internally.

terms.name: Folder
terms.description: A directory organizing files within a repository.

terms.name: File
terms.description: A single file within a repository.

terms.name: Branch
terms.description: A parallel line of development within a repository.

terms.name: Tag
terms.description: A named pointer to a specific commit.

terms.name: ProcessScheme
terms.description: Facet: What operations or events occur in a repository.

terms.name: Commitsss
terms.description: A single snapshot of repository state at a point in time.

terms.name: Merge
terms.description: The process of combining changes from one branch into another.

terms.name: Release
terms.description: A packaged version of software at a specific point in time.

terms.name: Clone
terms.description: The action of creating a local copy of a remote repository.

terms.name: PullRequest
terms.description: A proposal to merge changes from one branch into another.

terms.name: ToolScheme
terms.description: Facet: What software manages the repository.

terms.name: Git
terms.description: Distributed version control system.

terms.name: SVN
terms.description: Centralized version control system (Apache Subversion).

terms.name: Mercurial
terms.description: Distributed version control system (legacy).

terms.name: ScopeScheme
terms.description: Facet: Access, visibility, and location.

terms.name: Local
terms.description: Repository exists only on local machine.

terms.name: Remote
terms.description: Repository is hosted on a server.

terms.name: Private
terms.description: Repository access is restricted to authorized users.

terms.name: Public
terms.description: Repository is accessible to everyone.
